headline: The Good Ladds Drop 191 and Nut Olave Forgets How to Score
subhead: Week 5 served up a 191-point nuke, a 47-point bench coma, and Nick Celli politely scoring like it's a bye week.
matchOfTheWeek: Christian McCalfinjury edged Egbukkake by a measly 3.46 in the game of the week, with both teams clearing 164. The Mascot (31.3) and Proven Auto-start Kyren (31.1) did everything humanly possible for Szara, but Dak (28.28) and CMC (27.9) refused to let mattwunder lose a game named after his own franchise. Bonus indignity: Wunder left Jacory Croskey-Merritt and his 27 points rotting on the pine and STILL won.
powerRankingsShakeup: The Good Ladds just put up 191.72 and are officially the scariest team in the league, while Nut Olave Your Face is freefalling after a 107-point whimper that looked like a punt formation.
mainRecap:
The Good Ladds didn't just win, they committed a war crime. 191.72 points, Jonathan Taylor going for 31.6, 3rd Overall Somehow doing 3rd-overall things, and Mig still left David Njoku and his 21.7 on the bench like he was saving him for a rainy day. Rub My Chubb dropped 173 — the kind of number that wins almost any week of the season — and got run off the field. Rico Dowdle (32.4), Ja'Marr Chase (29), and AJ Barner randomly going full Gronk for 27.8? Doesn't matter. BigD got cooked by a higher power.

Meanwhile in the dunce corner, Nut Olave Your Face mustered a league-low 107.08 against T swift's Baddies. Where was Big Penix? Where was Mustard? Where was Better Than Bo? Nick, your whole roster is built on nicknames and not one of them showed up. Tnicolle didn't even need to try.

McBridesStrangeWhiteHock pulled off the lineup crime of the season — 47.66 points on the bench. Sam Darnold went for 28.64 in street clothes, Theo Johnson added 24.3 from the recliner, and LargestOfRocks STILL lost to Browning Out. Then he traded for Malik Nabers like that fixes anything. Speaking of Browning Out — Patrick, your namesake QB Jake Browning dropped 22.14 on YOUR bench. The team is literally called Browning Out and you benched Browning. Read the room.

Stroud Boys rode C.J. Stroud's 28.76 past OnlyFants, and Little Peckers cruised over QAmon behind Mahomes' 27.72 — Kyle, Turf Toe Joe and dead rat aren't walking through that door, my guy. Tough scene in QAmon-land.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 47.66 on the bench and immediately ran to the trade block — bro, the problem isn't your roster, it's your lineup tab.

weeklyAwards.title: Participation Trophy
weeklyAwards.blurb: 107 points in a SuperFlex league is the fantasy equivalent of getting tackled in the parking lot.

weeklyAwards.title: Demolition Permit
weeklyAwards.blurb: 191.72 with Njoku's 21.7 still on the bench — Mig was bored by halftime and somehow kept scoring.

weeklyAwards.title: On-Brand Malpractice
weeklyAwards.blurb: Benched Jake Browning for 22.14 points. The team is literally named after him. Read your own logo.
